in_scope.instructions:
Welcome to the Tines VDP! 

As this is an open VDP, there is no monetary bounty commitment associated with this program; any bounty rewards will be due to exceptional reports, both in the findings and in the quality of the report, and are solely at the discretion of Tines.

As this is a marketing and documentation application, there is no authentication, and all resources should be publicly available.
